earth.name: Earth
earth.desc: Condense from a lone droplet into a world-scale liquid core.
earth.objective: Clear Earth levels 1-10 and defeat the world-stage boss T10.
earth.complete: Earth's liquid signal is stable. A red planet has opened on the route.

mars.name: Mars
mars.desc: Survive thin atmosphere, iron dust, and pressure-starved flow.
mars.objective: Clear Mars levels 11-25 and break the red planet guardian T25.
mars.complete: Mars has yielded. The ringed giant is now within reach.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.desc: Shape liquid energy through rings, ice, and orbital debris.
saturn.objective: Cross Saturn levels 26-45 and defeat the ring guardian T45.
saturn.complete: Saturn's rings have aligned with your current. Uranus is unlocked.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.desc: Turn cold atmospheric pressure into deeper cosmic flow.
uranus.objective: Master Uranus levels 46-70 and collapse its defense field T70.
uranus.complete: Uranus is complete. Neptune's deep blue gravity is calling.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.desc: Enter the storm edge before the route expands toward stars and anomalies.
neptune.objective: End the Planet Arc across levels 71-100 by defeating Neptune's final boss T100.
neptune.complete: The first planetary route is complete. Stellar chapters remain beyond this MVP.

cosmos_ageUniverse.title: THE AGE OF THE UNIVERSE
cosmos_ageUniverse.body: The universe is 13.8 billion years old. Most of that time was spent waiting for atoms to cool, stars to form, and you to show up.
cosmos_ageUniverse.twist: And yet, here you are, drinking water and tapping a bottle.

cosmos_observableSize.title: THE OBSERVABLE UNIVERSE
cosmos_observableSize.body: About 93 billion light-years across — and that is only the part where light has had time to reach us. The full universe could be unimaginably larger.
cosmos_observableSize.twist: Everything you have ever seen is the corner of a corner of a corner.

cosmos_galaxyCount.title: HOW MANY GALAXIES
cosmos_galaxyCount.body: At least two trillion galaxies, each filled with hundreds of billions of stars. Most of them you will never know existed.
cosmos_galaxyCount.twist: Every dot in the night sky is a city you will never visit.

cosmos_blackHoleTime.title: BLACK HOLE TIME
cosmos_blackHoleTime.body: Near the event horizon of a black hole, time stretches. One hour for you could be seven years for someone far away.

cosmos_andromedaCollision.title: THE ANDROMEDA COLLISION
cosmos_andromedaCollision.body: In about 4.5 billion years, the Milky Way and Andromeda will merge into a single new galaxy.
cosmos_andromedaCollision.twist: Nobody asked them. They are doing it anyway.

cosmos_cmb.title: STATIC FROM THE BIG BANG
cosmos_cmb.body: The faint static on old TVs was partly the afterglow of the Big Bang itself, finally reaching your antenna.
cosmos_cmb.twist: The universe was broadcasting. We just had bad reception.

cosmos_fermiParadox.title: THE FERMI PARADOX
cosmos_fermiParadox.body: The universe is vast and ancient. By all reasonable math, we should be drowning in alien civilizations. We see none.
cosmos_fermiParadox.twist: Where is everyone? Maybe they are very, very quiet.

cosmos_darkMatter.title: DARK MATTER
cosmos_darkMatter.body: About 85% of the matter in the universe is invisible. We cannot see it, touch it, or detect it directly.
cosmos_darkMatter.twist: Most of the universe is something we have never met.

cosmos_voyager.title: VOYAGER'S JOURNEY
cosmos_voyager.body: Voyager 1 has been flying away from us since 1977. At its speed, it would take 40,000 years to reach the nearest star.
cosmos_voyager.twist: A piece of us is out there, slowly leaving the neighborhood.

cosmos_greatAttractor.title: THE GREAT ATTRACTOR
cosmos_greatAttractor.body: Our entire galaxy is being pulled toward something enormous we cannot see directly, hidden behind the Milky Way's bulge.
cosmos_greatAttractor.twist: Something out there is calling us in. We are going.

quantum_superposition.title: SUPERPOSITION
quantum_superposition.body: A particle can be in two places at once — but only until you look at it. The moment of observation collapses it into one.
quantum_superposition.twist: Reality is shy. It changes when you stare.

quantum_entanglement.title: ENTANGLEMENT
quantum_entanglement.body: Two particles, once entangled, can change together instantly across any distance — even across the entire universe.
quantum_entanglement.twist: Some bonds are stronger than space itself.

quantum_observerEffect.title: THE OBSERVER EFFECT
quantum_observerEffect.body: At quantum scales, the act of measuring something changes what is being measured. There is no neutral observation.
quantum_observerEffect.twist: You cannot peek without leaving fingerprints.

quantum_tunneling.title: TUNNELING
quantum_tunneling.body: Particles can pass through walls they classically should not be able to cross. The Sun shines partly because of this.
quantum_tunneling.twist: Right now, somewhere in your body, an electron is breaking a rule.

quantum_emptyAtom.title: YOU ARE MOSTLY EMPTY
quantum_emptyAtom.body: Atoms are 99.9999999999996% empty space. If you removed all the empty space from every human, humanity would fit in a sugar cube.
quantum_emptyAtom.twist: You are a very convincing illusion of solidity.

quantum_waveParticle.title: WAVE OR PARTICLE
quantum_waveParticle.body: Light behaves like a wave when you ask it wave questions, and like a particle when you ask it particle questions.
quantum_waveParticle.twist: Reality answers the question you actually asked, not the one you meant.

quantum_planck.title: THE PLANCK LENGTH
quantum_planck.body: Below 1.6 × 10⁻³⁵ meters, the very concept of distance stops making sense. Space becomes foam.
quantum_planck.twist: Zoom in too far, and the floor disappears.

quantum_zeroPoint.title: ZERO-POINT ENERGY
quantum_zeroPoint.body: Empty space is not empty. Even a perfect vacuum contains an enormous amount of energy in constant motion.
quantum_zeroPoint.twist: Nothing, it turns out, is busy.

quantum_manyWorlds.title: THE MANY WORLDS
quantum_manyWorlds.body: One interpretation of quantum physics says every choice splits reality. Every coin flip creates two universes.
quantum_manyWorlds.twist: Somewhere, you made the other choice. You are doing fine there too.

quantum_foam.title: QUANTUM FOAM
quantum_foam.body: At the smallest scales, reality is not smooth. Particles flicker into and out of existence in a chaotic bubbling foam.
quantum_foam.twist: The ground floor of reality is bubbling like soup.

earth_innerCore.title: THE INNER CORE
earth_innerCore.body: Earth's inner core is a solid ball of iron about the size of the Moon, spinning slightly faster than the surface.
earth_innerCore.twist: There is a tiny iron moon inside our planet, doing its own thing.

earth_age.title: HOW OLD WE ARE
earth_age.body: Earth is 4.5 billion years old. Life appeared around 3.8 billion years ago, so almost all of Earth's history has had life on it.
earth_age.twist: Life showed up early and refused to leave.

earth_olympusMons.title: MOUNT EVEREST IS SHORT
earth_olympusMons.body: Olympus Mons on Mars stands 22 km tall — almost three times the height of Everest.
earth_olympusMons.twist: We have the wrong planet for serious mountaineering.

earth_pacific.title: THE PACIFIC IS HUGE
earth_pacific.body: The Pacific Ocean contains nearly half of the planet's free water. Every continent on Earth could fit inside it.
earth_pacific.twist: One ocean. It could swallow everything and still have room.

earth_continentsMove.title: CONTINENTS MOVE
earth_continentsMove.body: The continents drift 2–5 cm per year. The Atlantic gets wider each year by roughly the length of a fingernail's growth.
earth_continentsMove.twist: Geography is just very slow weather.

earth_breath.title: EVERY BREATH IS HISTORIC
earth_breath.body: Each breath you take statistically contains atoms once breathed by people who lived thousands of years ago.
earth_breath.twist: The air remembers, and it is in your lungs right now.

earth_lightning.title: LIGHTNING IS HOTTER THAN THE SUN
earth_lightning.body: A lightning bolt can reach about 30,000 °C — five times hotter than the surface of the Sun. Briefly.
earth_lightning.twist: The sky throws tiny stars at the ground sometimes.

earth_glassRain.title: GLASS RAIN
earth_glassRain.body: On the planet HD 189733b, winds reach 8,700 km/h and it rains sideways drops of molten glass.

earth_lightToAndromeda.title: LIGHT FROM EARTH
earth_lightToAndromeda.body: Light reflecting off Earth right now will reach the Andromeda galaxy in 2.5 million years.
earth_lightToAndromeda.twist: You are leaving a trail across the universe whether you want to or not.

earth_oxygenApocalypse.title: THE OXYGEN APOCALYPSE
earth_oxygenApocalypse.body: When cyanobacteria first produced oxygen, it was a deadly poison. It nearly wiped out all life on Earth.
earth_oxygenApocalypse.twist: The air we love almost killed everything.

life_lastAncestor.title: THE LAST COMMON ANCESTOR
life_lastAncestor.body: Every living thing on Earth — every tree, fish, bacterium, you — descends from a single common organism that lived 4 billion years ago.

life_youAreShip.title: YOU ARE A SHIP
life_youAreShip.body: You carry more bacterial cells in your body than human cells. You are less a person and more a moving ecosystem.
life_youAreShip.twist: Technically, you are a city with a name.

life_brainPower.title: BRAIN POWER
life_brainPower.body: Your brain uses about 20% of your body's total energy. It runs on roughly 20 watts — less than a dim light bulb.
life_brainPower.twist: All your dreams are powered by a desk lamp.

life_sharks.title: HUMANS ARE NEW
life_sharks.body: Modern humans have existed for around 300,000 years. Sharks have existed for 450 million years. They have outlasted entire forests.
life_sharks.twist: Sharks were practicing before we even had hands.

life_tardigrades.title: TARDIGRADES
life_tardigrades.body: Tiny water bears that survive space vacuum, boiling water, freezing temperatures, and radiation. They will be here long after we are not.
life_tardigrades.twist: The future inherits whoever is hardest to kill.

life_octopus.title: OCTOPUSES THINK WITH THEIR ARMS
life_octopus.body: Two-thirds of an octopus's neurons are in its tentacles. Each arm partly thinks for itself.

life_trees.title: TREES TALK
life_trees.body: Forests share nutrients and chemical signals through underground fungal networks. The trees know who their neighbors are.
life_trees.twist: The wood beneath you is gossiping.

life_whaleLanguage.title: WHALES HAVE CULTURE
life_whaleLanguage.body: Different whale pods sing different dialects and pass them down through generations. They have culture in the open ocean.
life_whaleLanguage.twist: Somewhere right now, a whale is teaching another whale a song.

life_immortalJellyfish.title: THE IMMORTAL JELLYFISH
life_immortalJellyfish.body: Turritopsis dohrnii can revert to its juvenile form and biologically never age out of existence on its own.
life_immortalJellyfish.twist: Aging is not a law of nature. It is a habit.

life_dnaTeaspoon.title: DNA STORAGE
life_dnaTeaspoon.body: All the DNA from every person alive on Earth would fit inside a single teaspoon.
life_dnaTeaspoon.twist: All of us, in a spoon.

future_sunDeath.title: THE SUN WILL DIE
future_sunDeath.body: In about 5 billion years, the Sun will swell into a red giant, swallowing Mercury, Venus, and probably Earth.
future_sunDeath.twist: The lights stay on for a while yet.

future_heatDeath.title: HEAT DEATH
future_heatDeath.body: Eventually, in around 10¹⁰⁰ years, the universe runs out of usable energy. Everything goes dim, cold, and still.
future_heatDeath.twist: The universe ends in a slow exhale, not a bang.

future_lastStars.title: THE LAST STARS
future_lastStars.body: In about 100 trillion years, the last star will run out of fuel. Then only black holes will remain, slowly evaporating.
future_lastStars.twist: The night sky is on a long timer.

future_protonDecay.title: PROTON DECAY
future_protonDecay.body: Even matter is not eternal. Protons may decay over 10³⁴ years. The atoms themselves eventually unwind.
future_protonDecay.twist: Patience is a feature of physics.

future_frozenCosmos.title: A LONELIER SKY
future_frozenCosmos.body: The universe is expanding faster every year. Eventually, every galaxy will be too far away to ever see again.
future_frozenCosmos.twist: The night sky will go dark, one galaxy at a time.

future_simulation.title: THE SIMULATION QUESTION
future_simulation.body: Some physicists argue that the math of reality looks suspiciously like a simulation. The numbers fit too well.
future_simulation.twist: If this is a sim, hi to whoever is reading the logs.

future_greatFilter.title: THE GREAT FILTER
future_greatFilter.body: Why have we not met aliens? Maybe most civilizations destroy themselves before they can leave their home planet.
future_greatFilter.twist: The universe may be quiet because the rest already failed.

future_aiAscent.title: AI ASCENT
future_aiAscent.body: Within decades, we may build minds that think a million times faster than us, in directions we cannot follow.
future_aiAscent.twist: The future may not be human, but it will be ours to invite in.

future_generationShips.title: GENERATION SHIPS
future_generationShips.body: Reaching another star realistically means building cities that fly for thousands of years, carrying generations who never see Earth.
future_generationShips.twist: A childhood spent looking out the same window into nothing.

future_theEnd.title: THE END
future_theEnd.body: In the deepest future, nothing remains but cold and silence. But the universe got 13 billion years of being awake. So do you.
future_theEnd.twist: It is not nothing to have happened at all.

water_origin.title: WHERE WATER CAME FROM
water_origin.body: Most of Earth's water arrived on icy comets and asteroids during the chaotic early years of the solar system.
water_origin.twist: Your morning glass is delivery from outer space.

water_marianaDepth.title: DEEPER THAN MARIANA
water_marianaDepth.body: The Mariana Trench is 11 km deep. Sunlight effectively dies before 1 km. Most of the ocean is dark.
water_marianaDepth.twist: Most of Earth is a basement we never visit.

water_iceWeird.title: ICE IS STRANGE
water_iceWeird.body: Solid water floats on liquid water. Almost no other substance in the universe does this. Life as we know it depends on it.
water_iceWeird.twist: Fish survive winter because of a weird trick of chemistry.

water_71percent.title: 71 PERCENT
water_71percent.body: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered in water. Of all of that, only 0.001% is in the average glass on a table.
water_71percent.twist: We are a planet drowning in fresh paint.

water_europa.title: THE OCEANS OF EUROPA
water_europa.body: Beneath the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa, there is more liquid water than in all of Earth's oceans combined.
water_europa.twist: A bigger ocean is waiting, just colder and farther away.

water_timeCapsule.title: WATER IS A TIME CAPSULE
water_timeCapsule.body: Water cycles forever. The water you drink today may have once been inside a dinosaur or a thunderstorm a million years ago.
water_timeCapsule.twist: You are sharing a glass with everyone who ever lived.

water_heavyWater.title: HEAVY WATER
water_heavyWater.body: Add a neutron to hydrogen, and water becomes heavier. "Heavy water" looks the same but is denser and slightly toxic.
water_heavyWater.twist: Same flavor, different mass. Reality has variants.

water_everywhere.title: ONE WATER MOLECULE
water_everywhere.body: A single water molecule has likely been inside thousands of organisms, oceans, and rivers throughout history.
water_everywhere.twist: Your tap water has lived more lives than you have.

water_deepLayers.title: THE OCEAN HAS LAYERS
water_deepLayers.body: Below 1 km of ocean it is permanently dark and freezing. The creatures there often make their own light.
water_deepLayers.twist: An entire world lit only by what its inhabitants chose to glow.

water_antarcticLakes.title: HIDDEN LAKES
water_antarcticLakes.body: There are more than 400 lakes of liquid water buried under the Antarctic ice. Some have been sealed off for millions of years.
water_antarcticLakes.twist: There are rooms on this planet nobody has ever entered.
